different AZ, different node

span.p:
MTU budget
1500 minus WireGuard ~80 minus VXLAN ~50 = 1370 private
1400 public, set by Hetzner vSwitch
both written by cloud-init, never guessed by the guest

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Capacity ceiling
32 MACs per vSwitch port means at most ~32
public NICs per node before frames are dropped.
The control plane refuses allocation past the cap.
